# Project Context (LLM-optimized)

## Directives
- GRAPH-FIRST: explore code via `specd graph`; grep/glob only non-code or last resort. Stale/missing graph → `specd graph index`.
- `specs/` = requirements SoT; never edit directly. Workflow: draft → implement → review → approve → merge → archive. No code without spec; read/update existing specs; avoid duplicates.
- Artifacts, code, comments, docs English. Full spec: `specd specs context <id>`; include globals with `default:*`.
- TypeScript pnpm ESM monorepo. Hexagonal+DDD: domain no I/O; application ports; infrastructure adapters; rich entities enforce invariants; pure stateless services; manual DI.

## Global Specs — load full via `specd specs context <id>`

### default:_global/architecture
- Business packages: domain → application → infrastructure; inner layers never import outer. Domain no I/O; application uses ports; infrastructure excludes composition.
- Entities own invariants/typed transition errors; value objects expose behavior; stateless domain services are exported functions.
- Ports abstract classes with explicit methods. Constructor DI; no IoC/singletons. Validate external YAML at infrastructure boundary; typed `SpecdError`.
- Composition alone imports infrastructure. `createKernel`, `createKernelBuilder`, capability factories share resolver; canonical `createX(deps)`. Public barrels exclude concrete adapters.
- Adapter packages contain no business logic. Dependencies: plugin-* → skills → core; cli/mcp → sdk; sdk → core|code-graph; schema-* standalone; no cycles. Cross core/graph hosts use `@specd/sdk`.

### default:_global/conventions
- Strict TypeScript; `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, ESM NodeNext. Named exports; kebab-case; explicit public returns; no `any`; expected errors use `SpecdError`; immutable domain.

### default:_global/testing
- Vitest; test tree mirrors src; `.spec.ts`; Given/When/Then; no snapshots. Domain/application unit tests mock I/O. Integration uses unique `os.tmpdir()` dirs and cleanup. Ensure cross-platform paths, fixtures, line endings.

### default:_global/docs
- Docs only under `docs/{adr,cli,code-graph,core,guide,mcp,schemas,sdk,skills}`; exceptions: root README, AGENTS, CLAUDE.
- `docs/guide`: title/description/sidebar_position frontmatter; user usage only; configuration/workflows match core; begin with What is SpecD; cover skills, project update, plugins, graph. Keep SDK/package internals outside guide.
- ADR: sequential `NNNN-kebab-case`, MADR, Decision Outcome Confirmation + More Information/Spec; link source specs only.
- Every CLI command needs docs/cli page, index, sidebar; MCP schemas/examples in docs/mcp. Public symbols need full JSDoc.
- Hosts document/import `@specd/sdk` only. SDK collections under `docs/sdk/{core,code-graph,skills,schemas}` require frontmatter. Update affected docs for public composition, template/config cascades, list-contract changes.

### default:_global/eslint
- Type-aware TypeScript: forbid any/default exports; require explicit returns, kebab-case, JSDoc, layer boundaries. Lint before commit.

### default:_global/continuous-integration
- CI on macOS/Ubuntu/Windows for PR+main; pnpm 10.6.5, Node 22, frozen install; build → typecheck → test.

### default:_global/error-handling-conventions
- Expected user failures: `SpecdError`, `specd=true`, UPPER_SNAKE code, actionable message, JSON/TOON metadata.

### default:_global/logging
- Console-compatible `log/info/debug/warn/error`; info for normal events; fatal/trace through error/debug prefixes; abstraction over raw console.

findings.title: No test asserts facet-only adapter shape
findings.reason: No test inspects the TypeScript adapter for facet objects and absence of loose getPackageIdentity/resolvePackageFromSpecifier/etc. methods (they are private class methods, never asserted absent from the public surface).

evidence.detail: no assertion on absent loose members

findings.title: No test for capability flags vs facets independence
findings.reason: No test sets capabilities().hierarchy true with no packageResolution and checks the indexer treats hierarchy as supported and package resolution as absent.

evidence.detail: only core-only adapter test, no capability flag combination

findings.title: Per-file facet throw not tested
findings.reason: Tests cover prepare throwing, but none covers a present facet throwing for a single file's import resolution with the error recorded and other files still indexed.

findings.title: Go adapter lacks relative facet not asserted
findings.reason: No test asserts the Go adapter exposes no relativeImportResolution.

findings.title: Go adapter lacks qualified-name facet not asserted
findings.reason: No test asserts the Go adapter exposes no qualifiedNameResolution.

findings.title: resolveToPath no-FS-access not asserted
findings.reason: Test only checks repeated results; it never verifies absence of filesystem access after prepared metadata.

findings.title: Re-export link no-I/O not asserted
findings.reason: Link tests check outputs only; none verifies that link reads no file from disk.

findings.title: Go prepare does not store module path and code root
findings.reason: Spec says prepare reads each workspace go.mod once and stores module path and code root; implementation prepare only builds the per-run Go directory index and entrySurface derives the directory from request.packageName/workspace. Behavior matches scenarios, wording diverges.
findings.recommendation: Align spec wording with implementation or store module data in prepare

findings.title: No test asserts Pass 2 performs no filesystem I/O
findings.reason: Implementation shows no fs use in package-import-resolver or the Pass 2 import loop, but no test spies on or forbids filesystem access during Pass 2 import resolution.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that fails if fs is touched during Pass 2 import resolution

findings.title: No test for facet vs capability flag independence
findings.reason: No test asserts that providing reExportLinking does not cause an adapter to advertise hierarchy capability; conformance tests only check advertised capabilities against fixtures.

findings.title: No test asserts composer.json read once per workspace
findings.reason: No test counts composer.json reads during packageResolution.prepare or asserts Pass 2 does no filesystem reads; prepare also reads each composer.json twice for identity and PSR-4 map.

evidence.detail: preparePackages calls buildPsr4Map and getPackageIdentity per workspace
PHP prepared helper has no read-count assertion

findings.title: PHP package-unknown reason not asserted end to end
findings.reason: Tests assert matchSpecifier returns undefined for an unmapped name, but none asserts the PHP import yields no persisted result with reason package-unknown.

evidence.detail: Given a name no prefix matches

findings.title: Type-only package import type-space lookup untested
findings.reason: Implementation passes spaces [Type] for typeOnly imports, but no test asserts a same-name value-space export is ignored for a type-only package import.

evidence.detail: only barrel-chain type import, no value-space competitor

findings.title: Namespace package import entry dependency untested
findings.reason: No test covers namespace package import depending on the entry file and member access resolving only through published names.

findings.title: PHP resolveToPath performs uncached filesystem I/O
findings.reason: qualifiedNameResolution.resolveToPath in the PHP adapter calls buildPsr4Map, which walks up and reads composer.json via findManifestField on every call. Only packageResolution.identity and prepare may perform I/O.
findings.recommendation: Parse composer.json autoload metadata in packageResolution.prepare and have resolveToPath read session or codeRoot prepared state

findings.title: PHP resolveToPath does not use prepared autoloader metadata
findings.reason: The SHOULD to read parsed autoloader metadata prepared per codeRoot or session is not met: PHP resolveToPath re-reads and re-parses composer.json on each call, with no session or per-codeRoot cache.

evidence.detail: buildPsr4Map called from resolveQualifiedNameToPath without caching

findings.title: Provenance path not asserted
findings.reason: The resolver test only checks status resolved and that the target id contains zlib; it does not assert the ordered path (local binding, import:package step, public binding, logical target).

evidence.detail: resolved.target id contains zlib only; no path assertion

findings.recommendation: Assert result path steps and kinds in the cross-workspace resolve test.

findings.title: No same-name symbol trap in unresolved test
findings.reason: The unresolved fixture imports Missing, which does not exist anywhere in zlib, so the test cannot prove a unique same-name symbol in the package workspace is not chosen.

evidence.detail: Missing is not declared in zlib/src/lib.z2

findings.recommendation: Add a fixture where the package workspace declares the name once but does not export it, and assert unresolved.

findings.title: No test for hydrated workspaces being prepared
findings.reason: Implementation passes all options.workspaces to prepare, but no test runs an incremental run and asserts prepare receives unchanged workspaces.

evidence.detail: packageWorkspaces built from options.workspaces and passed to prepare
only asserts prepare is called once

findings.title: No test for package identity collision error
findings.reason: Collision error is produced naming both workspaces, but no test asserts it.

findings.title: Test entries discarded unconditionally
findings.reason: Spec says a test-classified entry candidate is discarded unless the specifier addresses it; resolver filters category test with no exception branch.

evidence.detail: entryFiles filter drops category test unconditionally
only the discard half is asserted

findings.title: No package-import test for workspace added
findings.reason: No test covers an unresolved package import becoming resolved after the target workspace is added incrementally; newly resolvable integration cases use relative imports.

evidence.detail: newly resolvable case is relative import

findings.title: Closure no-scan not asserted
findings.reason: No test asserts the closure uses only persisted steps and hydrated bindings and reads no unrelated files.

findings.title: Package identity collision untested
findings.reason: Collision error naming both workspaces is implemented but no test asserts it.

findings.title: Test-entry filter ignores explicit specifier
findings.reason: Spec keeps test entries when the specifier addresses that file explicitly; resolver always drops test-category entries.

findings.title: facet-absent counted in import failure totals
findings.reason: Absent-facet diagnostic goes through recordImportDiagnostic, inflating total/byReason/samples which spec defines as unresolved package imports.

findings.title: symbolReferenceSyntax.render signature differs from spec
findings.reason: Spec requires render(member: LogicalSymbol, options?: RenderSymbolReferenceOptions): RenderedSymbolReference; implementation declares render(symbol, ownerPath: readonly string[]) returning an inline {generic; native?} type. RenderSymbolReferenceOptions and RenderedSymbolReference types do not exist, and all adapters plus docs follow the divergent signature.
findings.recommendation: Align the facet signature and add the named types, or amend the spec to the ownerPath form

findings.title: Docs checklist steps 6-7 differ from spec steps
findings.reason: Spec requires the docs page to state the same rules. Spec step 6 is passing the cross-language conformance suite and facet scenarios; step 7 is writing the adapter spec and adding it to the built-in list. Docs step 6 lists ad hoc test items and step 7 omits the built-in list.

evidence.detail: Checklist for a new language steps 6-7

findings.title: Python packageResolution.prepare is a no-op
findings.reason: Spec requires prepare to read each workspace pyproject.toml once and entrySurface to use only that stored data plus the indexed file set; prepare is a no-op and entrySurface hardcodes src/ and workspace-root candidates without stored project name or code root.

evidence.detail: prepare returns undefined; entrySurface ignores prepared data

findings.title: Manifest data not stored by prepare
findings.reason: Spec says package identity and the data stored by packageResolution.prepare come from [project].name; prepare stores nothing, identity is read separately via getPackageIdentity.

findings.title: Submodule import creates no namespace binding
findings.reason: from pkg import models adds the file dependency but the code only continues; no namespace binding of models to the module is created. No test covers this scenario.

findings.title: No test that prepare reads pyproject once
findings.reason: No test exercises Python packageResolution.prepare or asserts one read per pyproject.toml and no filesystem read in entrySurface; prepare does nothing.

evidence.detail: Python entry surface has no prepare test

findings.title: No Python test for name found elsewhere
findings.reason: No Python test asserts an imported name existing elsewhere in the target project stays unresolved.
